record.question: The _________ are a very important part of the medical record and are statements written by the doctors regarding the patient's progress and condition at regular intervals.
record.explanation: Answer D: Progress notes. Progress notes are the clinicians’ regular entries documenting a patient’s course, condition, and response to treatment. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK482263/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
